📜 Spin history

    👥 Friends

    📸 Friend snapshots (manual share codes)

    Friend snapshots — ask a friend to send you their share code; import a newer code anytime to update their progress. A snapshot is the run your friend exported at that moment (not live — for live progress, use a live group above).

    🗺 Mission Packs

    Mission packs group related challenges into subgroups — across rarities — so a series like “Survive 100 / 250 / 500 / 1000 Floors” is tracked together. Open a pack, then a subgroup, to work on its challenges. Deleting a pack or subgroup never deletes the challenges inside it.

    Fan-made tracker. Toon & trinket names and images from the Dandy's World Fandom Wiki (CC BY-SA). Dandy's World © BlushCrunch Studio. Saves live in this browser's localStorage. Export your run to back it up or share it.

    Challenge tab
    Rarity / badge tier

    Bronze badge · no reward.

    Progress — pick any combination

    Combine modes freely — e.g. Counters with a Checklist attached. At least one mode must stay selected.

    Counter goals

    Add up to 20 counters. Each needs a label and target, and each counter counts as one condition (see “conditions met” below).

    Checklists

    Give each checklist a name and its items, one per line (up to 100 items across all lists). Check off each step as you complete it. Use Exclude for items that do not apply; every included item counts as one condition. On the card, each checklist can be shown or hidden on its own.

    Tick the challenge's main checkbox when the goal itself is done — the goal counts as one condition.

    Leave blank (or 0) to require all conditions. Each included checklist item, each counter, and the goal itself each count as one condition — e.g. set 2 to complete when any 2 of 3 conditions are met.

    Icon (optional)

    Pick an image — it is shrunk to at most 128×128 and stored inside the challenge.

    Default spin (used when Reward = Default)

    A completed Toon challenge earns a Toon spin.

    Reward

    The reward is yours to choose, whatever the rarity — rarity stays as the badge/title color. “Default” keeps the standard reward above (tab spin, or the badge-tier reward for team goals).

    %

    Completing this challenge earns one revival chance at this success rate. Spin it from the wheel panel: success earns a Revival Spin, failure uses it up.

    Shown as the earned reward on the challenge card. The site displays it — it can't automate made-up effects.

    Choice chance — how it plays

    Each gamble rolls its own % when the credit is spent. A gamble's prize can be a random Toon/Trinket — or one specific item you name. In “Pick one”, the player chooses a single gamble to roll; in “Roll all”, every gamble rolls. 100% always succeeds.

    Choice options — what “Your choice” can pick

    When this challenge's reward is “Your choice”, the player picks one of these. Tick at least one — if none are ticked, Toon + Trinket are used.

    Extra rewards (optional · up to 3 · granted in addition to the reward above)

    Extra rewards are granted when the challenge is completed, alongside the main reward. A “Choice” extra becomes a Choice credit in the wheel panel — spend it there to pick from its options. A targeted revival lets the player pick the exact Toon or Trinket to revive.

    Put this challenge in a mission subgroup (see the Mission Packs tab). While it is in a subgroup with a shared counter, its counters can link to that shared counter.

    An excluded challenge still works and earns its reward — it just doesn't count toward 100% completion anywhere.
